notes:
- Overview names what is wrong in one line, with a checklist, and shows This Mac: model, chip, memory, macOS, displays and drives.
- This week: the hottest apps, battery life and where disk space went, saved as CSV or PDF, with an optional Monday notification.
- Battery shows the charger, what it gives and why charging is slow or on hold, and the battery's capacity against new.
- Network shows the Wi-Fi connection, this Mac's address and every drop today, with an alert when it drops.
- Memory lists apps and dev servers holding memory while idle, with Quit.
- Projects shows every open port on the Mac, grouped, and old Claude Code and Codex sessions to clear.
- Sensors shows earbuds left, right and case, the last day and time left.
- Two optional menu bar items: dev servers running and the lowest Bluetooth device.
- Alerts keeps its history in its own scrolling column.
- Offline mode asks one simple question when it goes on.
